items.question: Who was appointed the World Health Organization Director-General’s Special Envoy for Health Resilience?
items.explanation: The WHO appointed Dr Vanessa Kerry as the Director-General’s Special Envoy for Health Resilience.

items.question: Which organisation appointed Dr Vanessa Kerry as Special Envoy for Health Resilience?
items.explanation: The appointment was made by the World Health Organization.

items.question: Where was Dr Vanessa Kerry’s appointment as WHO Director-General’s Special Envoy for Health Resilience announced?
items.explanation: The appointment was announced in Geneva.
